name: Checkers
description: English draughts for two players on an 8x8 board.

start.description: Optional starting position: 64 cells, row 8 first, a..h within a row; '.', 'b', 'B', 'w', 'W'. Empty = standard setup.

draw_after.description: Moves in a row without a capture that end the game in a draw.

brief.situation: A game of checkers (English draughts) between Black and White on an 8x8 board. Only the dark squares are used.
brief.rules: Squares are named like chess: columns a-h left to right, rows 8 (top) to 1 (bottom). On the board, b/w are Black/White men, B/W are kings, '.' is empty. Black starts at the bottom and its men move up (toward row 8); White starts at the top and its men move down (toward row 1). A man moves one square diagonally forward onto an empty square (written c3-d4). A capture jumps diagonally over an adjacent enemy piece onto the empty square just beyond it, removing that piece (written c3xe5). Captures are mandatory: when any capture is available you must capture. After a capture, if the same piece can capture again it must keep jumping in the same turn, one jump per move call. A man that reaches the far row is crowned a king, which ends the turn; kings move and capture both forward and backward. A player with no legal move on their turn loses. The game is a draw after {$inputs.draw_after} moves in a row without a capture. Your move tool only lists legal moves.

roles.player: You play {$actor.name}. Win by capturing or blocking every enemy piece.

board.default: $inputs.start if $len($inputs.start) == 64 else $map($range(64), ('w' if $it // 8 < 3 else ('b' if $it // 8 > 4 else '.')) if ($it // 8 + $it % 8) % 2 == 1 else '.')
board.description: 64 cells, index = row*8 + col, row 0 is row 8 on the board.

chain.description: Square of the piece that must keep jumping, or -1.

quiet.description: Completed moves in a row without a capture.

valid.expr: $mine($world.board[$k // 8], $color) and ($world.board[$k // 8] in ['B', 'W'] or $dr($k) == $forward($color)) and $tr($k) >= 0 and $tr($k) < 8 and $tc($k) >= 0 and $tc($k) < 8 and $world.board[$dest($k)] == '.' and ($k % 2 == 0 or $enemy($world.board[$mid($k)], $color))

boardline.expr: '   a b c d e f g h' if $r == 8 else $join([$text(8 - $r), ' |', $join($map($range(8), $world.board[$r * 8 + $it]), ' ')], '')

finish_turn.description: Close the current player's turn and hand the move to the opponent.

move.description: Make one move or one capture jump. Steps are written from-to (c3-d4); jumps are written fromxto (c3xe5). After a jump, if the same piece can jump again you will be asked to continue.

then.fail: {$params.move} is not a legal move. Legal moves: {$join($labels($actor.color))}.

move.outcome: You played {$params.move}.{$' Crowned a king.' if $crown else ''}{$join([' Captured a piece; you must jump again with the same piece (', $sqname($d), ').'], '') if $more else ''}

stages.name: move
stages.brief: Your move. Pick one legal move.

status.title: Status
status.show: You are {name}: your pieces are {$'b (men) and B (kings)' if $actor.color == 'b' else 'w (men) and W (kings)'}; your men move toward row {$'8' if $actor.color == 'b' else '1'}. Pieces: you {$count_side($actor.color)}, opponent {$count_side('w' if $actor.color == 'b' else 'b')}. Moves without a capture: {$world.quiet} of {$inputs.draw_after}.

must_jump.title: Continue
must_jump.show: You just captured and must keep jumping with your piece on {$sqname($world.chain)}.

legal.title: Your legal moves
legal.show: {$join($labels($actor.color))}{$' (a capture is available, so you must capture)' if $len($jumps($actor.color)) > 0 and $world.chain < 0 else ''}

invariants.why: Every removed piece is a counted capture.

end.name: no_legal_move
end.say: {$pick(player, $it.color == $world.turn).name} has no legal move and loses.

end.name: draw
end.say: Draw: {$inputs.draw_after} moves in a row without a capture.
